items.title: Semiconductor stocks sink over fears of increased competition from China
items.summary: Worries over increased competition from China sent semiconductor stocks lower on Monday.

items.title: Tech stocks today: Investors eye SpaceX's first earnings report
items.summary: Tech stocks coverage for the week of Aug. 3.

items.title: These 3 ETFs Turn Market Fear Into Double Digit Monthly Income
items.summary: Options sellers have quietly been harvesting the gap between investor fear and actual market volatility, and three ETFs package that trade into monthly paychecks using very different mechanics that make them far from interchangeable.

items.title: S&P Global Grew Revenue 10% and Still Missed on Earnings. Except, Maybe It Didn't.
items.summary: The consensus bottom-line forecasts most investors were comparing its results to didn't appear to factor in changes stemming from a recent spinoff, or any one-time costs related to it.

items.title: The Market Is Missing a Huge Opportunity in NVIDIA, Micron, and Broadcom
items.summary: NVIDIA, Micron, and Broadcom have powered some of the most explosive earnings in market history, yet each stock trades at a fraction of what its forward numbers could justify. Here is where the math points by 2027.

items.title: Seagate and Western Digital Dive 6%, SK Hynix and Micron Slide 5% as Memory Stocks Cool
items.summary: Memory stocks are taking a sharp hit Monday after an extraordinary run, but Wall Street analysts and a major insider are already treating the selloff as something very different from what the price action suggests.

items.title: Amazon Gets Upgraded to the $3 Trillion Club
items.summary: Amazon shares jumped 5% this morning, propelling the company to a $3.08 trillion market valuation. The gain comes on the heels of a 15% jump on Friday, when Amazon stock had its best day in years after investors liked what they saw in its latest report card.

items.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Just Reclaimed a $2 Trillion Market Cap. It Still Trades at About 20 Times Forward Earnings.
items.summary: The chip foundry giant is back at a milestone valuation with a market-average multiple attached. That combination deserves a closer look.
